description:
A test execution machine for automating SoapUI and ReadyAPI tests at scale. Run tests in parallel; deploy faster.


- TestEngine 1.36.1 is a patch release.
- Security Mitigation for CVE-2026-114938
  A high-severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-114938, CVSS 3.1 score 8.1) affects the OpenJDK Compiler component. The Java runtime in TestEngine relies on this component. On x86-64 systems with AVX-512 VBMI, the vulnerability allows remote code execution through memory corruption. Attackers can exploit it only by supplying data to affected APIs, for example, through a web service.
  TestEngine 1.36.1 includes the JVM flags that mitigate the vulnerability. Upgrade to TestEngine 1.36.1 to apply the mitigation. TestEngine 1.37.0 will update the bundled OpenJDK version to fix the vulnerability.
- Workaround for Earlier Versions
  If you cannot upgrade yet, add one of the following flags to the JVM startup parameters:
  - Disable Base64 intrinsics (recommended): -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics
  - Disable AVX-512 execution (x86-64 only): -XX:UseAVX=2
  Both flags can affect application performance. Test them in your environment before a wide rollout.
  To apply the flag, add it to the JVM options file for TestEngine, then restart the application:
  - TestEngine: ReadyAPITestEngine.vmoptions or ReadyAPITestEngine-service.vmoptions
  - Docker: Set the JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS environment variable, for example, -e JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics".
  For help, contact SmartBear Support.
